subject: integration
name: THORChain network standard (THORNODE_NET_0_1)
summary: A definition of THORNODE_NET_0_1, marked browser-only: a site's ask is answered as for an unknown code. Groups quote and status (risk 2) give the browser's own payments a swap quote (amount out, fees, the vault and router to send to), the vault of each chain and a deposit's status. The definition calls a deposit's status the node's word, to be checked on the destination chain; it cannot check a quote or a vault address, which is where a swap is paid to. The row names no node or address. Level 4 with privacy as a definition. Judged here by its publisher.
